A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Tail Annealing for Heavy-Tailed Flow Matching. All 18 pages of each version, including tables, equations and Appendices A–E, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic benchmark experiments in Section 5 and Student-t, financial-data, solver-ablation and baseline-validation results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix E, including the multivariate synthetic benchmark and Fama–French evaluation.

M1.justification: Hill-gated soft-log preprocessing, the flow-matching objective, inverse-transform sampling and the continuous transform family in Appendix D are unchanged.

E1.justification: The same copula-based synthetic benchmark, Student-t scenarios and financial-data evaluations are retained in Section 5 and Appendix E. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: Arcsinh-FM, TTFfix, TTF and gTAF remain in the main comparisons, with mTAF retained in the relevant Appendix E comparisons.

E3.justification: Data splits, sample sizes, metrics, network configurations, training settings and sampling procedures are identical in Section 5 and Appendix E. No evaluation protocol is revised.

E4.justification: The Hill-gating, output-clamping and Euler-step ablations are unchanged, as are the stability analysis and baseline-validation comparisons. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Repeated-run counts and statistical reporting are unchanged, including main-benchmark medians over 20 replications, Table 7 means with standard errors, and Table 8 means with standard deviations over 10 replications.

E6.justification: All empirical entries in Tables 1–5 and 7–10 are unchanged. For example, Table 8 retains Fama–French W1 values of 0.133 ± 0.013 for Log-FM and 0.127 ± 0.007 for gTAF; reported findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, propositions, derivations and proofs are unchanged, including the regular-variation proofs in Appendix C and the parametrized soft-log construction in Appendix D.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about tail annealing, the transform, benchmark performance and stability. Text flowing onto another page does not change their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of tail lightening, dependence preservation and baseline behavior are unchanged. The qualifications concerning tail indices below one and architectural limitations in high dimensions are also retained.

D1.justification: v2 newly acknowledges access to IDRIS (Jean Zay) HPC resources through GENCI. This adds limited computational-resource provenance; implementation details, hyperparameters and code/data access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive positioning relative to earlier heavy-tailed flows, diffusion models and flow matching are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgements section, names Jean Pachebat in the correspondence line, and replaces the preprint notice with conference proceedings information. Scientific prose and section organization are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised publication footer and added acknowledgements cause limited column and page reflow, principally on pages 1–3 and 10. Tables, algorithm displays and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding and HPC attribution and updates publication information, but retains the same scientific text, theory, experiments, results and appendices. The modest provenance disclosure and layout adjustments do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
